places.name: cenci (チェンチ)
places.neighborhood: 聖護院円頓美町44-7, Sakyo, near Heian Shrine, in a renovated house over 100 years old down a narrow entrance — 12 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Keihan), 15 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Italian built on Kyoto vegetables and Japanese ingredients — Kujo green onion, Shogoin daikon, rapeseed flowers, wasabi; fish sometimes aged for days (Tabelog) · weekday lunch, 6 dishes and 2 desserts, ¥12,100; weekend and holiday lunch ¥16,940; lunch or dinner, 8 dishes and 3 desserts, ¥24,200 (Tabelog, tax included; the official menu page lists ¥12,100 and ¥21,780); service 10% (Tabelog) · extra pasta about ¥2,000 or risotto about ¥4,000 at lunch (August 2026) · official sample dinner: prosciutto with potato and yuzu kosho; gazpacho with sakura shrimp; tomato, new ginger, cutlassfish and coriander; asparagus, barley and squid; Kamigamo cucumber with retired-dairy-cow beef and sesame; Chinese chives, turban shell and chitarra · 2026 reviews: prosciutto with mango, passion fruit and dosa; ayu with tagliolini; Gifu Tada ham with bean mousse and ricotta; a vegan plate of cucumber, miso and melon (August); hamo soup reminiscent of tom yum with Manganji peppers and coriander, new-squid risotto (October); the meal ends with "cenci", small fried pastries · wines chosen by a sommelier; tea pairings for non-drinkers (official site; October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区聖護院円頓美町44-7

places.name: 竹屋町 三多 (Takeyamachi Mita)
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi, on a quiet street just south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi bus stop, 10 min from Jingu-Marutamachi, Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: One seasonal kaiseki course a night, on historic tableware (2026 reviews) · seasonal course ¥67,000 (September 2026); the autumn Matsutake gathering ¥75,000 including tax and drinks (October 2026); diners report ¥50,000–79,999 (Tabelog) · August 2026: egg tofu with Yura sea urchin sauce, stick sushi of Awaji horse mackerel with young ginger, steamed Setouchi abalone with fried asparagus and liver sauce, Akashi sea bream, hamo in white miso, charcoal-grilled Ariake eel, eggplant with soft-shelled-turtle sauce, sudachi somen, then three corn rices (plain, butter, black pepper) · September 2026: salmon roe with yam, Matsutake spring rolls, Akashi horse mackerel sushi, hamo with miso, grilled white sweet sea bream, hairy crab, abalone and eggplant in turtle broth, Matsutake clay-pot rice · October 2026: Matsutake spring rolls with dried sea-cucumber roe, Awaji mackerel sushi, sea bream with kombu and sea urchin, grilled cutlassfish with Matsutake, chateaubriand with chestnut flour and sansho, Matsutake rice · sake such as "Kuro-ryu" (as an October 2026 review writes it)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区寺町通竹屋町下ル久遠院前町667-1

places.name: 未在 (Mizai)
places.neighborhood: Inside Maruyama Park beyond Yasaka Shrine, at the far end of the park; the entrance is easy to miss — 15 min on foot from Gion-Shijo (Keihan) or Kawaramachi (Hankyu)
places.cuisine: Tea kaiseki in the house style (未在流献立): it opens with rice and a soup bowl as in a tea meal, moves through generous sashimi with many condiments, fish, meat and hamo, then a large hassun, a scorched-rice tea porridge, a big spread of fruit and matcha whisked by the owner (official site; 2026 reviews) · cuisine charge ¥65,000 plus tax and 10% service; market price in January and October; the tea room (private room) ¥35,000 extra (official site); Tabelog lists the "Mizairyu tea kaiseki" at ¥78,000 including tax · portions are famously large; diners are told to come hungry, and many leave some (2026 reviews) · an original sake made with the Kyoto rice Iwai (September 2026); wine, priced on asking (June 2026) · a house blend of eight spices, "八味", ¥2,000 a bottle or ¥3,500 for two, ordered by phone (official site)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区八坂鳥居前東入ル円山町613 円山公園

places.name: 八寸 (Hassun)
places.neighborhood: Gion, through a stone-paved passage behind a plain noren — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan), 8 min from Kawaramachi (Hankyu)
places.cuisine: Omakase kaiseki from a second-generation Gion kitchen, with natural hamo in summer and Tanba Matsutake in autumn (Tabelog) · omakase kaiseki lunch ¥13,200; dinner ¥27,500 (Tabelog, tax included) · lunch in September–October 2026: steamed fig with sesame sauce or sesame tofu, a hassun (river goby, hamo roe, Yawata roll, sweet potato, smoked egg yolk), tuna and sea-bream sashimi, a dobin-mushi of hamo and Matsutake, grilled sawara, seasoned or Matsutake rice, pickles and fruit · dinner in October 2026: yuba steamed with maitake and koutake, duck loin, seared hamo, sea bream with sea-urchin soy sauce, the season's last Matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi, charcoal-grilled sawara with black Manganji pepper and miso, crab in vinegar, wild eel from Mie grilled over charcoal · sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園末吉町95

places.name: 大市 (Daiichi)
places.neighborhood: Kamigyo, where Shimonaga-cho street (as a June 2026 review spells it) meets Senbon-dori — about 18 min on foot from Kitano-Hakubaicho Stn, or a taxi
places.cuisine: One dish, soft-shelled turtle "marunabe", in a set course: a small dish of turtle jelly or simmered turtle with ginger, the hot pot served twice (different cuts each time), then rice porridge with rice, mochi and eggs, pickles and seasonal fruit (2026 reviews) · course ¥26,000 including tax and service, lunch or dinner; extra hot pot from ¥10,600 per person; porridge refills offered (Tabelog) · the pot is cooked fast over coke in thick custom clay pots from Shigaraki that take on flavour over years (July 2026); diners were told of a heat of 1,600 degrees (July, September 2026) · drinks: beer and sake, priced on the bill (two beers and two sake ¥8,000, October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市上京区六番町364

places.name: 草喰 なかひがし (Soujiki Nakahigashi)
places.neighborhood: Jodoji, Sakyo, at the start of the approach to Ginkaku-ji — 3 min from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop; 10 min by car from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Wild plants, flowers and vegetables the owner gathers each morning in Ohara, in a set course: a hassun like a scene from the hills, soups, simply grilled dishes, then rice cooked in a wood-fired okudo-san stove with grilled dried sardines and pickles, refills free (official site; Tabelog) · lunch from ¥12,100, dinner from ¥24,200 including tax and service (official site); from 1 April 2026 lunch from ¥10,000 and dinner from ¥20,000 before tax and service (official notice) · extras at a charge, such as Matsutake rice +¥4,000 (September 2026) or tamago-kake-gohan (October 2026) · September 2026 lunch: a hassun on a lotus leaf, ayu with uruka, summer venison with autumn vegetables, Matsutake rice topped with karasumi · October 2026: Matsutake with soft-shelled turtle, carp sashimi, grilled eel, roast wagyu, bamboo-shoot rice; okoge and ochazuke at the end · sake such as Eiketsu and Shinsei (October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区浄土寺石橋町32-3

places.name: IL GARAGE (イル ガラージュ)
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori below Sanjo, on the second floor above a garage — 7 min from Karasuma Oike Stn, 9 min from Karasuma/Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A seasonal course of Italian regional cooking with "a pinch of creativity", built on Japanese produce (official site; Tabelog) · lunch course ¥13,200 plus service (February 2026); diners report about ¥16,000 at lunch and ¥20,000–39,999 at dinner (2026 reviews) · bigoli, the thick Veneto pasta, made fresh every morning; Sicilian cannoli filled with sweet shrimp, home-made karasumi and sudachi purée as a starter (Tabelog) · February 2026 lunch: home-made ham with strawberries; Wakayama squid with puntarelle; Mie flounder with celeriac; Ibaraki whitebait pasta with cima di rapa; Nanatani duck with tartiflette; charcoal-grilled Kumamoto red beef; butterbur-bud ice cream; bonet · July 2026: cod with bottarga, beef prosciutto on Pione grapes, horse mackerel · game in autumn and winter (Tabelog) · an extensive wine list, with drinks recommended by Midori (July 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区道祐町147 2F

places.name: El Tesoro (エル・テソロ)
places.neighborhood: Yamato-oji below Sanjo, Yamato Bldg 1F, near Shinbashi in Gion — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn, 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: A cocktail and whisky bar: original cocktails made to your taste, with seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails the draw (official site; 2026 reviews) · examples: passion fruit, grape, watermelon with a salt rim, espresso martini, martini with large olives, Tanqueray gimlet, sidecar, screwdriver, a "Sky Ball" in a mug (July–October 2026) · whiskies including vintage bottles and Ardbeg An Oa (August, October 2026) · home-made cakes with the drinks: Basque cheesecake, chocolate cake, cinnamon cake, a dessert with a coffee cocktail (July–August 2026) · table charge ¥1,000; diners spend about ¥3,000–9,999 (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区大和大路通三条下ル三丁目弁財天町19番地 大和ビル一階 E号室

places.name: 山元麺蔵 (Yamamoto Menzou)
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, near the zoo — 2 min from the Okazaki-koen Dobutsuen-mae bus stop, 11 min from Higashiyama Stn exit 1
places.cuisine: Freshly made, freshly boiled udon with a natural bonito dashi (official site) · hot udon: the spicy "Red Menzou Special" with burdock tempura, fried mochi and egg; beef and shaved burdock; pork; Kyoto curry udon; chicken tenderloin tempura; burdock tempura; vegetable tempura; spicy meat-miso; kitsune, ankake, tamago-toji and more · "aromatic oil" versions with garlic, ginger and leek oil · tsukemen with a hot dipping broth (beef and burdock, beef offal, curry, pork); cold zaru udon · small tempura rice bowls with egg yolk; almond tofu; bottled beer (official menu) · toriten miso udon ¥1,700 (October 2026); diners spend ¥1,000–2,999 · the signature is the crisp burdock tempura, and the noodles are so long that scissors come with them; a mini almond tofu often comes free (October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区岡崎南御所町34

places.name: 啐啄 つか本 (Sottaku Tsukamoto)
places.neighborhood: Gion, on Nishi-hanamikoji street — about 5–7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: An omakase kaiseki of simple, ingredient-first Japanese dishes with notably well-balanced sauces and dressings (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥35,000–37,000 with sake (August and December 2025); diners report ¥30,000–49,999 (Tabelog) · summer 2025: corn with tomato jelly, simmered Awaji octopus, fig and walnut with sesame, charcoal-grilled hamo with salted wasabi and plum, grilled anago sushi, grilled ayu, grilled abalone, clay-pot rice with Manganji peppers · winter 2025: seiko crab, soft roe, duck, crab rice porridge · October 2026: fig and chestnut, pressed mackerel sushi, sea bream sashimi with chrysanthemum and dashi, a soup of Matsutake and hamo · Japanese sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-120

places.name: やまぐち (Yamaguchi)
places.neighborhood: Gion, in a renovated townhouse — about 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan), 3 min from the Gion bus stop
places.cuisine: An omakase that blends Japanese and Italian cooking around luxury ingredients — sea urchin, abalone, truffle, caviar, beef fillet — and the seasons (Tabelog) · from ¥46,000 including tax, plus 10% service (Tabelog); course ¥42,000 (September 2026); diners report ¥50,000–79,999 with drinks · October 2026: a crème-brûlée of black fig and foie gras terrine with buckwheat (with Alba white truffle on one night), sea urchin with dried-scallop jelly and cauliflower, kombu-pickled turnip with Spanish mackerel or sweet sea bream and caviar, chilled capellini with sweet shrimp and fruit tomato and bottarga grated as freely as you like (the signature), Ezo abalone steak with Matsutake risotto, charcoal-grilled beef fillet, a crab carbonara made without dairy, chestnut shaved ice · wine pairings by a sommelier
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-185

places.name: 中国菜 Guu
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-Nijo, on Nijo-dori next to the police box — about 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tozai Line)
places.cuisine: A monthly Chinese omakase of 8–9 dishes cooked at full flame in an open kitchen, with dim sum made fresh, plus extra orders such as fried rice or mapo tofu (Tabelog) · omakase ¥25,000 (September 2026); a pairing of five drinks ¥8,900 (September 2026); diners report ¥20,000–39,999 · signature: a swan-shaped pastry of potato dough around daikon, honey-cooked apple and blue cheese (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · 2026: kombu-cured abalone or sea bream with top-grade jellyfish and herb-lemon sauce, char siu with pickled tomato and myoga, freshly steamed shrimp shumai and xiao long bao, Peking duck (breast skin, then back), shark fin, Kagoshima beef fillet, octopus with Sichuan-pepper noodles, a wonton soup with Omi beef offal, Peking duck ramen · a "super high heat" fried rice as an extra · takeaway XO sauce (September 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区樋之口467-2

places.name: きう (Kiu)
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma, Shimogyo, second floor — about 5–6 min from Karasuma Stn (Hankyu)
places.cuisine: Creative sushi: about six small dishes, then nigiri on soft rice seasoned with white balsamic vinegar (2026 reviews) · diners report ¥40,000–59,999 · September–October 2026 small dishes: bonito with sea grapes or chrysanthemum, Matsutake fried in a crust of crushed kaki-no-tane rice crackers, Awaji hamo shabu-shabu, hairy crab with sea urchin and ginkgo, scallop with spicy daikon and black shichimi, Amakusa sea eel · nigiri: shirohoshi fuedai, sayori, Lake Biwa trout, kohada, lean and fatty tuna, kamatoro, nodoguro with kombu and yuzu pepper, a kanpyo roll; whale bacon in November 2026 · a broad sake list; Inedit beer (September 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区神明町230-2 2F

places.name: 飯田 (Iida)
places.neighborhood: Anekoji-dori west of Tomikoji, south side (as a May 2026 review gives the address) — about 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 10 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: A kaiseki course rooted in tea kaiseki, served on museum-grade tableware by Rosanjin and Eiraku, with Taisho-era glass and contemporary pieces (Tabelog) · about ¥57,000 with drinks (May 2026); diners report ¥50,000–79,999 · May 2026: eel Yawata-maki (a May-only dish), thin soybean kuzu tofu with abalone, a soup of fried carp with yomogi noodles, lightly seared aburame sashimi, seared bonito with wild garlic and myoga, sea bream chumaki sushi with edamame, grilled young ayu · June 2026: a clear soup of hamo and ume · October 2026: Matsutake · a welcome cup of ume kombu tea (May 2026) · sake and wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区姉小路富小路西入ル南側

places.name: 木山 (Kiyama)
places.neighborhood: West of the Kyoto Gosho (Imperial Palace), ヴェルドール御所 1F — about 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Karasuma Line)
places.cuisine: Kaiseki that begins and ends with water from a well found on the site: a cup of hot well water, then katsuobushi shaved in front of you, tasted as arabushi and honkarebushi, and turned into the first dashi; then seasonal dishes, small soups, grilled fish, a choice of about five closing rice and noodle dishes in sizes you pick (with refills), and usucha (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch ¥18,870 (August 2026); dinner diners report ¥30,000–49,999; two diners paid ¥102,780 with a Matsutake supplement and a sake-and-wine pairing (October 2026) · August 2026: natural eel from the Sanpōgoko lakes (as one review writes it) over corn rice, potato purée with scallop and red sea urchin, horse mackerel with bitter melon and egg-yolk vinegar, abalone and liver tofu soup, Biwa trout and hanadai sashimi; Lake Biwa trout roe; a summer watermelon course at lunch · September 2026: taro, sweet shrimp and tofu; Ise lobster cake; anago with mushrooms and crisp rice; fermented ginger and daikon · October 2026: large Nagano Matsutake; a clam-dashi ramen among the closing dishes · pairings of wine and sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区絹屋町136 ヴェルドール御所 1F

places.name: 祇園 さゝ木 (Gion Sasaki)
places.neighborhood: Yasaka-dori east of Yamato-oji, south of Kennin-ji, in a house reached up a flight of steps — about 10–15 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A Kyoto kaiseki of the day's best ingredients, bought at markets and fishing ports by the chef, served to everyone at once with theatre at the counter (Tabelog; official site) · lunch ¥22,000, dinner ¥44,000 including tax and service, varying with the market (official site) · July 2026 lunch: watermelon juice, grilled Mikawa eel, box sushi for the Gion Matsuri, hamo in mixed rice, a corn tempura dessert · September 2026: abalone and liver rice porridge, octopus with home-made karasumi in a chestnut burr, sweet sea bream soup, flounder sashimi cut by the chef, an extra-large cutlassfish grilled over charcoal, sesame tofu made with warabi starch; at dinner somen with crab and caviar, sushi handed over by the chef, shark-fin soup and an all-you-can-eat marinated tuna rice bowl · May 2026: Awaji hamo with egg yolk and water eggplant, young Lake Biwa ayu with watermelon sauce, nodoguro with wakame jelly · Japanese sake and wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区八坂通大和大路東入小松町566-27

places.name: 御料理 はやし (Oryori Hayashi)
places.neighborhood: Kamigyo, a quiet lane across from the Kitamura Art Museum, just over the Kamo Ohashi bridge — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn, 2 min from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto kaiseki with no menu and no explanations, so that diners wonder what each dish is; the price of the course decides the fish for sashimi and the grill rather than the number of dishes (2026 reviews) · lunch ¥15,730 including tax, plus 10% service (October 2026); diners report about ¥6,000–19,999 at lunch and ¥30,000–39,999 at dinner · August 2026: a persimmon or quince aperitif, assorted starters with ginger, a shrimp dumpling soup, white miso in summer, winter melon, a swordfish soup tied with mitsuba, grilled sea bream, young ayu tempura, kuzu noodles, a cold rice porridge, ume as a dessert, sweet beans with matcha · October 2026: salt-grilled sea bream collar, sashimi of sea bream, squid and bonito with salt vinegar · an original sake served ice-cold in a metal vessel (August 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市上京区梶井町448-61

places.name: にしぶち飯店 (Nishibuchi Hanten)
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama near Yasaka Shrine, a machiya with a white noren at the end of a quiet lane — about 586 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Modern Kyoto-style Chinese: Chinese technique with Japanese finesse, served kappo-style in a machiya with a small garden (Tabelog) · signature: shark fin simmered, then grilled, in a full-bodied superior broth (Tabelog) · diners report ¥30,000–39,999 · October 2026: abalone fried with liver sauce, chicken wings stuffed with bird's nest with char siu and Gorgonzola, saury marinated in Shaoxing wine, braised shark fin, roast beef, free-range chicken with Matsutake, saury fried rice, almond shaved ice with muscat and pear; stir-fried beef with fermented black beans; fried rice with grated daikon; Tianjin rice; shirasu fried rice and cold noodles · September 2026: abalone risotto, Hyogo sweet shrimp with scallion oil, char siu · Shaoxing wine in small jars (also with soda), wine and champagne
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区上弁天町444-2

places.name: 安参 (Yassan)
places.neighborhood: Gion, a townhouse with red lanterns on the north side of the main street, across from Gion Ichiriki-tei — about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion beef kappo with no menu: dishes come in order, light to rich, to your appetite — pickled cucumber and a cold oxtail soup with grated yam, then about four beef sashimi (tongue, heart, lean, blanched tripe with ponzu or ume), grilled cuts, and the oxtail stew (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews) · the oxtail stew, made since the founder's day by adding to the same sauce, with tongue, heart, cheek and sirloin, potatoes and eggs; eat the tail with your hands at the end; Kujo green onion and mustard on the side (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · grilled: tongue, liver, skirt, sirloin rolled around kaiware sprouts (2026 reviews) · oden; white rice to make a stew bowl · diners spend about ¥10,000–19,999 · gourd sake at New Year (Tabelog) · beer, barley-shochu sodas, sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側347

places.name: 祇園 にし (Gion Nishi)
places.neighborhood: Near Yasaka Shrine, on Higashioji-dori about 50 m from the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing — about 8 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki with an Italian-trained chef's ideas — ingredients and techniques Japanese cooking does not usually use — and a showpiece hassun (official site; Tabelog) · lunch omakase ¥19,360 including tax and service (August 2026); dinner a little under ¥30,000 (August 2026) · June 2026: 長芋素麺と蓴菜に大間の雲丹, a white-miso bowl of 牡丹鱧, sashimi of aori squid, tuna, sea urchin and nodoguro, a hassun with lobster and corn mousse, 鮎の海苔巻き寿司, beef loin and Kamo eggplant with shrimp dengaku · August 2026: chawanmushi of sea urchin, abalone, shrimp, crab and caviar; a soup of ayu, Matsutake and winter melon; grilled hamo, squid and trout sashimi · curry to finish on request (July, August 2026) · wine chosen by the owner, a certified sommelier, and sake from a certified sake expert (Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区月見町21-2 1F

places.name: 真白 (MASHIRO)
places.neighborhood: Near Rokkakudo, OHG京都六角ビル 2F — 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5
places.cuisine: Genre-free cooking on a French base, with a drop of soy sauce or miso and a pinch of spice, built on produce sent direct from growers (official site; Tabelog) · the only fixed dish is the opening "Uni" (read "umi"): creamy sea urchin and a seawater jelly in a rice-cracker cup, eaten in one bite (Tabelog) · pairing ¥8,800 at lunch, ¥11,000 at dinner, from champagne, sake and white, red, rosé and orange wines (Tabelog) · diners report ¥15,000–19,999 at lunch and ¥30,000–39,999 at dinner · roasted managatsuo under Parmesan "fish bones" (Tabelog) · September 2026: Yosano-rice mushroom risotto with fresh salmon roe, caviar with Shinkansen pear and burrata, Korean mackerel, French lamb with peanut sprouts · October 2026: a rice-porridge soup, scallops with porcini, local chicken, a near-two-metre cutlassfish, Tajima beef top sirloin · August 2026: Hida beef · message plates for celebrations (Tabelog; July–August 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区堂之前町234 OHG京都六角ビル 2F

places.name: 室町和久傳 (Muromachi Wakuden)
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori below Oike, in a renovated machiya with a garden — 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto ryotei cooking at a counter that surrounds the chefs, from a house that began as an inn in Tango in 1870 (Tabelog) · lunch ¥13,000 / ¥25,000 / ¥35,000; dinner ¥25,000 / ¥35,000; sake pairing courses lunch ¥23,000, dinner ¥37,000 or ¥50,000; crab course about ¥70,000 (November–March); shojin course ¥25,000 (book three days ahead); all including tax and service (official site) · autumn 2026: a chrysanthemum dish of crab, sea urchin and caviar in jelly for the Choyo festival; fried ayu with chestnuts; seared bonito with dill; a Matsutake dobin-mushi with eel; narai-yaki — eel wrapped around Matsutake, a house dish of some fifty years; turtle and mushroom hot pot; Kyoto beef fillet; a choice of three closing rices (turtle zosui, saba sushi, beef sukiyaki on rice), with leftovers made into onigiri to take home; Uji matcha (September–October 2026) · sake pairings
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区堺町姉小路上ル丸木材木町679

places.name: 京 静華 (Kyo Seika)
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, second floor near Heian Shrine and the Biwako Sosui canal — about 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tozai Line)
places.cuisine: Delicate Chinese cooking that recreates methods from classical Chinese texts, with Kyoto morning-market vegetables (Tabelog) · seasonal course ¥25,000 (¥27,500 including tax), plus 10% service; special menus for whole-room bookings of up to 6 (official site; Tabelog) · the spring roll with a spicy sorbet opens most meals, with seasonal fillings: young ayu, firefly squid and caciocavallo (April 2026); scallop, truffle and caciocavallo (December 2025); butterbur and firefly squid (March 2026) · October 2025: a soup of shark fin, abalone, Matsutake and sea cucumber; char siu with figs; wagyu; crab sticky rice, meat buns and mushroom noodles from the steamer · December 2025: soft roe with a Sichuan sauce; a lotus-root cake · October 2026: Doman crab, black abalone, Densuke eel; congee · wine pairings with Burgundy and champagne; Shaoxing wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区岡崎円勝寺町36-3 2F

places.name: 菊乃井 本店 (Kikunoi Honten)
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, beside Kodai-ji (Tabelog), up the slope past Maruyama Park (October 2026 review) — about 920 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki in a ryotei founded in the first year of Taisho, cooked with the house well water "Kikusui no I" (Tabelog) · lunch ¥16,500 / ¥22,000 (shorter courses) / ¥33,000 / ¥55,000 / ¥77,000 / ¥110,000; dinner ¥33,000 / ¥55,000 / ¥77,000 / ¥110,000, with a shorter ¥22,000 course; prices include tax, plus 15% service (official site) · a new menu each month (September 2026 review) · September 2026: a lunch hassun of barracuda pressed sushi, ayu with uruka, ginkgo and matcha somen; a chrysanthemum bowl; hamo shabu-shabu; tuna sashimi with egg-yolk soy sauce · October 2026: a dobin-mushi of Matsutake and large hamo; ayu with roe shown live before grilling; beef with a miso sauce; persimmon and lotus-root namasu; saba sushi with saffron rice · sake and wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下ル下河原町459

places.name: ぎおん 阪川 (Gion Sakagawa)
places.neighborhood: Gion, in an old-style house in a side lane — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Keihan)
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo of the day's best ingredients — natural ayu, turtle, gurnard, bamboo shoots, Matsutake — cooked with a light hand, as a course or à la carte at market prices (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · course ¥22,000 (July 2026); à la carte at market price, e.g. first-of-season torigai ¥8,500 (July 2026); diners report ¥15,000–39,999 with drinks · three starters to begin, e.g. anago sushi, hamo tempura with shiso and ume, yuba (October 2025) · spring 2026: Tsukahara bamboo shoots as sashimi and grilled; Omi beef with flower pepper; simmered sea bream; shrimp taro with crab sauce; rice steamed in bamboo · summer 2026: hamo grilled half-done on a shichirin at the counter; sea urchin; sea-bream crackers · September 2026: marinated hamo with corn and muscat; Wakasa gurnard sashimi and grilled head; turtle stew and turtle hot pot; grilled meat with rice and red miso soup · sake such as Michizakari and Kuro-ryu
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-199

places.name: 祇園 にしかわ (Gion Nishikawa)
places.neighborhood: Shimogawara-cho, off the stone-paved lane between Yasaka Shrine and Kodaiji — near the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki that changes daily, with vegetables from the Ohara morning market and contracted farmers, dashi made with Yasaka Shrine's soft "Bijin no Mizu", Akashi sea bream and Numajima hamo, and sashimi that compares fish from different waters (Tabelog) · diners report ¥15,000–19,999 at lunch and ¥30,000–39,999 at dinner · May 2026 lunch: hiragai with urui and dashi jelly; fried Kamo eggplant in kuzu; hiragai and tuna; mackerel sushi; grilled white tilefish with its scales; wagyu shabu-shabu with flower pepper; ginger rice · July 2026: hamo and eggplant; the pressed mackerel sushi a diner called unforgettable · September 2026: autumn eggplant with black maitake and junsai in dashi jelly; hamo with kuzu and Matsutake; grilled eggplant with caviar; ayu with finger lime; fried Matsutake and Matsutake rice · October 2026: sweet sea bream with turnip purée; a hamo and Matsutake soup with chrysanthemum and ginkgo · sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下る下河原町473

places.name: 山玄茶 (Sangencha)
places.neighborhood: Gion, down a water-sprinkled stone alley just off Hanamikoji — about 12 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki in the spirit of Zen cooking and the tea ceremony, from a chef trained 20 years at Shofukuro (Tabelog) · diners report ¥10,000–14,999 at lunch and ¥30,000–39,999 at dinner; a ¥500 charge · sashimi with "mascarpone soy sauce" and chili vinegar (Tabelog) · February 2026: sweet shrimp and abalone with egg-yolk sauce, a crab soup, fugu dumplings, tuna sushi from Ine, Omi beef in white miso, then rice from the chef's home in Shiga with refills and toppings, and a very soft mizu-yokan · May 2026: abalone, sea urchin and sesame tofu; eggplant and rockfish soup; simmered kinmedai; young ayu; ayu sushi; marinated chutoro; fried conger eel · July 2026: Awaji sea bream, ayu grilled then lightly fried, somen in a hand-carved ice bowl, Shiga Koshihikari rice with ebi-mame, mango, a yokan from the Shofukuro tradition, matcha · Ebisu draft beer and sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側347-96

places.name: TAKAYAMA (タカヤマ)
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Shijo, GOOD NATURE STATION 2F — 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu)
places.cuisine: "TAKAYAMA Creative Experience": a course of about 25 small creative dishes on a modern-Italian base (official site; Tabelog) · ¥30,000 including tax and service at lunch or dinner (official site); from November to 11 January only a Winter Special Course, ¥35,000 (Tabelog); plus a ¥1,000 water charge · fixtures: a welcome juice coated in white chocolate printed with a QR code that opens the menu; "Japan Caviar" from Miyazaki on squid-ink potato chips in a white box (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · December 2025: foie gras choux with apple jam, a Takayama sandwich with truffle ice cream, gnocchi fritto with mortadella, Seiko crab and bottarga risotto, a mountain of Ohara vegetables · wine pairings, including an Australian rosé the chef recommended (July 2026); non-alcoholic drinks · sweets you can take home (February 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区河原町通四条下ル2稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 2F

places.name: LURRA°
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, a renovated townhouse over 250 years old, a minute from Higashiyama Stn exit 1 (Tozai Line)
places.cuisine: Wood-fired "hybrid" courses that mix Nordic and Japanese fermentation with the seasons, using vegetables the chef gathers in the Ohara countryside and fish and meat direct from producers, cooked over embers in a kiln and oven (Tabelog; official site) · diners report ¥30,000–59,999 at dinner · August 2026 dinner: purple sea urchin manju, horse meat tartare, hiramasa with dried strawberries and ponzu, edamame tofu panna cotta with gazpacho jelly, ravioli, Biwa trout roasted in the fireplace with clam chowder sauce, chicken, a plate of Kyoto vegetables, seaweed risotto, melon ice cream with hojicha cookies · August lunch à la carte: kanpachi aguachile, peach pasta, zucchini pizza, a French omelette with Boursin, the LURRA° burger, mango parfait and fried ice-cream doughnuts · wine, cocktails, and a non-alcoholic pairing; drinks by Yusuke Sakaibe, a cocktail-competition champion (Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区石泉院町396

places.name: 祇園 又吉 (Gion Matayoshi)
places.neighborhood: Gion, just off Hanamikoji, through a lattice door and a stone path — about 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki in the spirit of the tea meal, about 13 dishes, on tableware made to order by a pottery studio (official site; Tabelog) · lunch ¥20,000 at the counter, ¥22,000 in a tatami room; dinner ¥36,000 at the counter, ¥38,000 in a tatami room (Tabelog, from 1 June) plus service · January 2025: a hassun of kombu-cured flounder, dried persimmon with cheese, fried abalone, sesame tofu and salmon roe with yam; kinmedai with daidai, sesame and miso; anago chumaki sushi with sansho · February 2026: a crab-only sushi roll · March 2026: glutinous rice with clams; spicy chirimen with the rice, also sold as a souvenir · October 2026: new chestnuts; three sashimi including white sweet sea bream; a soup of red sweet sea bream; autumn mackerel with a liver sauce; fried fig dengaku with sesame miso and sea urchin; a hot pot of Ishigaki beef with tofu and greens; Niigata Koshihikari rice with Lake Biwa eel tsukudani · sake centred on Aramasa; good hojicha
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-123

places.name: 京懐石 吉泉 (Kyo Kaiseki Kichisen)
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, beside the Tadasu no Mori woods of Shimogamo Shrine — about 10 min on foot from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto kaiseki in the tea-ceremony style: about 13 dishes from ingredients the chef buys at the market from 4 a.m., opening with a cup of sake as a welcome and soups whose lid is sprinkled with dew (Tabelog; official site) · course ¥44,000 (March 2026); diners report ¥15,000–19,999 at lunch and ¥40,000–49,999 at dinner; plus 10% service · spring 2025: a white soup with pickled cherry blossoms, a crab-and-shiso dumpling soup, sushi of fatty tuna and the collar, a steamed sushi wrapped in egg and eel; gori simmered in soy · November 2025: Matsutake as dobin-mushi, grilled and simmered; crab; takikomi rice; matcha · March 2026: "Sakura-yu", a white broth with salted cherry blossoms; crab shinjo soup with wasabi flowers · May 2026: sea bream rice; tuna served as sashimi and then as sushi · sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区下鴨森本町5

places.name: カルバドール (Calvador)
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto City Hall, second floor of 若林ビル, with no sign outside — about 313 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: A bar devoted to Calvados, the Normandy apple brandy — over 500 bottlings, according to a May 2026 review, including old vintages and single casks bottled for the bar · examples: Toutain 34-year single cask for Bar CALVADOR, Lauriston 1963, Pays d'Auge 1973, Adrien Camut, a 52-year-old Calvados, a Calvados of 90% pear (2026 reviews) · cocktails: Jack Rose, a Calvados Manhattan, a long drink of Calvados and apple juice · Ichiro's Malt made for the bar, also as a highball · Calvados chocolates made with the Kyoto patisserie Assemblage Kakimoto · diners spend about ¥3,000–19,999; table charge ¥1,000
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区妙満寺前町446 若林ビル 2F

places.name: Bar Rocking chair (ロッキングチェア)
places.neighborhood: Miyukimachi-dori south of Bukkoji, a Kyoto machiya through a small garden — a few minutes south of Shijo-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A classic cocktail bar in a machiya, with seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails (official site; 2026 reviews) · examples: watermelon salty dog ¥2,200 (July 2026); Black Manhattan ¥1,980 and a Kamikaze (October 2026); a Delaware-grape gin and tonic (August 2026); gin sling, Old Fashioned, martini (September 2026); gin and tonic with Fever-Tree, mojito; cassis parisienne · "The Best Scene", the cocktail with which bartender Kato won a national bartender competition (August 2026) · food such as fresh pasta with oil sardines and Kujo green onion (June 2026) · cigars · table charge ¥880 with a snack; diners spend about ¥2,000–9,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区御幸町通仏光寺下る橘町434-2

places.name: 京趣味 菱岩 (Kyoshumi Hishiiwa)
places.neighborhood: Shinmonzen-dori, Higashiyama, just past the Tatsumi Bridge — 7 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto shidashi (catering) since 1829: boxed bento of Kyoto dishes to order (official site) · 梅 ¥3,780; 月 ¥4,860 (adds duck breast and bamboo-leaf sushi); 花 ¥6,480 (about 20 dishes, the best-loved); 松 ¥8,100; two-tier 白川 ¥11,880 (chirashi sushi, for about two), 八坂 ¥14,040 and 東山 ¥21,600 (for 3–4), limited numbers; 半月弁当 with a seasonal soup ¥4,320–5,940; 松花堂弁当 ¥7,020 and ¥8,640 (official site, tax included) · October 2025: sea bream sushi in bamboo leaf, dashi omelette, simmered shrimp, grilled Spanish mackerel, eel rolled Hachiman-style, roast duck breast, chicken matsukaze, sweet ayu with sansho, ginkgo · August–September 2026, limited lunch: hamo mabushi on rice with a fresh dashi omelette, shrimp shinjo soup, pickles and a grape jelly, ¥4,000–5,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区新門前通大和大路東入西之町213

places.name: ぎをん 遠藤 (Gion Endo)
places.neighborhood: Gion, inside the 楽宴小路 alley just off Hanamikoji — about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A counter kappo of seasonal fish, ordered à la carte from a handwritten menu of about 70 dishes, from sashimi, grilled and simmered fish to salads, omelettes, rice bowls and fried rice (Waraku 2024; 2026 reviews) · signature: a thick, rare-fried horse mackerel fry with Worcester sauce and mayonnaise (Waraku 2024; 2025–2026 reviews) · sashimi of Akashi sea bream, striped jack and tuna; white-grilled anago; braised sea bream head · winter: drunken Matsuba crab in sake (January and March 2026), koppe crab and fried oysters (December 2025) · spring 2026: braised baby octopus with roe, Omba bamboo shoots, sake-steamed sea bream head, beef cutlet, ginger pork, sea urchin and salmon roe rice bowl, grilled rice ball · sake list · diners spend about ¥15,000–39,999; Waraku gave ¥10,000–15,000 a head in 2024
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側347-118 楽宴小路内

places.name: 祇園 きだ (Gion Kida)
places.neighborhood: Gion, a hideaway in the 祇園町南側 lanes east of Hanamikoji — about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A generous Kyoto omakase with nigiri sushi, built on the idea of 因縁果, cause, condition and result (Michelin Guide; June 2025 review) · omakase ¥35,000 plus tax and service (Tabelog) · October 2026: Jin Goemon sweet potato with crab sauce, sweet sea bream from Yahatahama with Nara Matsutake soup, Miyazu sea bream, Kesennuma bonito, marinated tuna from Matsumae, Sakai anago, salmon roe and Muscat sushi, Kagoshima beef shabu-shabu, eel, mocha ice cream with Mont Blanc · November 2025: koppe crab omelette, fugu sashimi, eel and cucumber roll, crab hot pot in white miso, Matsuba crab fried rice, ¥59,000 with drinks · March 2026: sardine sushi, grilled eel · December only, "Izakaya Kida": oden, sashimi, sushi, grilled and fried dishes à la carte (¥32,800 for 19 dishes and 8 drinks, December 2025) · sake and wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-192

places.name: ひつじ (Hitsuji)
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori near the Kyoto Imperial Palace, a white awning marked ひつじ — about 7 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Natural-yeast donuts fried to order, served warm (2026 reviews) · since September 2026 the donuts are all round, with brown sugar in place of wasanbon (October 2026 review) · examples: Tanba black bean kinako ¥330–367, Hateruma brown sugar ¥330, Ippodo hojicha ¥350–378, cinnamon, chocolate ¥410–442, cream donut ¥500, chocolate custard ¥529, whole-wheat kinako (July–October 2026 reviews) · drinks for the counter: café latte, tea, coffee ¥500 · Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022, 2023
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区大炊町355-1

places.name: 森林食堂 (Shinrin Shokudo)
places.neighborhood: Nishinokyo, a quiet residential street north of Nijo Stn, behind a front full of plants — about 10 min on foot
places.cuisine: Spice curry: a daily set of two or three curries on one big plate with multigrain rice, pickles and side dishes, written up in a handwritten booklet (2026 reviews) · examples: grape-fed pork keema with spinach and a bonito soup curry ¥1,950; Kyushu chicken keema with lotus root and bamboo shoots; a hamo curry with hamo tempura; squid-ink duck keema; salmon, mushroom and eggplant; wild boar; black wagyu beef tendon; three-curry plates ¥2,050–2,450 (August–October 2026 reviews) · daily toppings such as tandoori chicken, braised pork belly or marinated bonito · peach lassi about ¥900; collaboration beers with a brewery, ¥850–900 · diners spend about ¥2,000–3,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区西ノ京内畑町24-4

places.name: VELROSIER
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi, second floor of GOOD NATURE STATION just south of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative Chinese omakase built on "add on" cooking — combining ingredients to create new tastes (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · lunch ¥11,000 or ¥20,000, dinner ¥22,000, shark-fin courses ¥30,000/¥32,000, tax included, +10% service (official site; TableCheck) · a drink pairing of Shaoxing wine, sake, champagne and wine (May and July 2026; a small pairing ¥9,000) · signatures: foie gras monaka with physalis (hozuki) jam; a deconstructed gyoza of chive chawanmushi under "chive snow"; Cantonese char siu with fried bonito; soup xiao long bao; almond tofu (2026 reviews) · autumn 2026: Matsutake soup dumplings, tuna and caviar spring roll, Shanghai crab with flat noodles of seven domestic wheats, pork loin with lotus root cake and flower buns
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区河原町通四条下ル2丁目稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 2F

places.name: 焼鳥 京都橘 (Yakitori Kyoto Tachibana)
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori near Kyoto City Hall, in a basement — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori omakase of Takasaka chicken (高坂鶏), a premium bird the official site says can be eaten raw: starter, sashimi, nine skewers, five small dishes, a palate cleanser, rice and dessert, ¥16,500 tax included (official site), plus 10% service (Tabelog) · dishes named on the site: chicken-broth chawanmushi, house pickles, kombu-cured breast nigiri, white-liver pâté, seasonal clay-pot rice, chicken-broth ramen · October 2026: white liver sashimi with sesame oil, sashimi of thigh, breast and gizzard, breast with kinome, negima, tsukune with Grana Padano, wings, tail, chicken soboro rice and ramen · liver and heart as extras (August 2026) · wine (mostly crisp whites) and seasonal sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区押小路通御幸町西入橘町612 バインオークAiina B1F

places.name: 実伶 (Mirei)
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori by Karasuma-Marutamachi, in a townhouse — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo ordered à la carte from about 50 dishes a day, in the portions you want; courses on request (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · charge ¥4,000 including the appetiser (Tabelog) · seasonal: white sweet sea bream from Yawatahama and Wakayama, Matsutake in autumn, Matsuba crab in winter (Tabelog shop text) · June 2026: hamo, guji, young Lake Biwa ayu, Kuwana clams, Kamo eggplant with kinome miso, fried horse mackerel and rock oysters, hamo rice, soba to finish · autumn 2026: Matsutake dobin-mushi with white sweet sea bream, new-season sanma, handmade soba, ayu kara-age, fried oysters, beef cutlet, grilled anago · sake and a short wine list · diners spend about ¥15,000–29,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町143-2

places.name: 出町ふたば (Demachi Futaba)
places.neighborhood: Demachi, on Kawaramachi-dori just west of the Kamo River bridges — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto rice-cake sweets to take away (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · the famous mame mochi with red peas and bean paste ¥290; chestnut mochi with two whole chestnuts ¥390 (October 2026) · seasonal: black-bean daifuku and chestnut red rice in autumn; the "Mochiya Chestnut Mont Blanc" with a Tanba chestnut, bean paste and mochi under chestnut paste made without cream (October 2026); hon-warabi mochi, mizore mochi and inaka mochi with yomogi (May 2026); fukumame daifuku with sweet potato (2025–2026) · three-colour dango, red rice
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236

places.name: ASSEMBLAGES KAKIMOTO (アッサンブラージュ カキモト)
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori by Teramachi, a converted townhouse just south of the Imperial Palace — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Cakes, chocolates and plated desserts from a chef who is pâtissier, chocolatier and cook at once; dinner courses by reservation (official site) · the signature "Assemblages" cake of chocolate mousse layered with banana, lemon, mango and caramel creams, about ¥900 (October 2026) · Mont Blanc ¥918 on a crisp pie base with lemon-scented fromage (October 2026) · plated "Le Jardin": a chocolate sphere melted with flaming strawberry brandy over shiso and pistachio ice cream and raspberries, ¥2,300 + tax (October 2026) · Zen, coffee mousse with mochi (September 2026) · baked goods: financier, madeleine, Florentine, Engadiner, blue-cheese sablé, caramel pie; orangettes and a chocolate saucisson · coffee and teas from ¥750 · dinner ¥15,800 before tax (official site)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区竹屋町通寺町西入ル松本町587-5

places.name: PTISSERIE.S salon (パティスリー エス サロン)
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori between Karasuma and City Hall, ground floor of ウェルスアーリ天保 — about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: The café branch of Patisserie S, whose main shop on Takatsuji-dori is takeaway only (official site; 2026 reviews) · signature cake "S": fromage blanc with lemon and grapefruit over raspberries and cranberry, ¥806 · other cakes: Chocolat Framboise, Saint-Marc, Masala, Seduir, a meringue cake, éclair, cream puffs; mille-feuille at the main shop on weekends · baked goods and "CSS" crunchy caramels · tea such as Earl Grey ¥750, iced coffee ¥682 · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区朝倉町546 ウェルスアーリ天保 1F

places.name: ぎをん 福志 (Gion Fukushi)
places.neighborhood: Gion, a quiet lane just off Hanamikoji — about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki at a seven-seat counter, centred on dashi and fine tableware (2026 review) · diners report ¥30,000–39,999 · February 2026: hassun with red clam, sweet shrimp and sea urchin, Tanba black soybeans; a clear soup of kinmedai and cod milt; Akashi sea bream and Awaji squid; grilled karasumi with daikon; grilled quail; grilled managatsuo; fried ebiimo with yuba sauce; beef simmered with seri; sea bream takikomi gohan; summer-orange jelly; matcha · 2025 courses included a hanasansho hot pot and a soba course · sake, shochu, wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-120

places.name: コリス (Korisu)
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori near Rokuharamitsu-ji, a brown-brick house — about 7–9 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku and bistro dishes à la carte, refined over two generations (2026 reviews) · starters: garlic-potato and shirasu canapés, a hearty baguette with tapenade and tomato, smoked salmon with mango, peach with finger lime and mimolette · thick pumpkin, butternut or beet soups · the house salad with ham, egg and tomato · signatures: macaroni gratin, hamburg steak with a fry (salmon, hamo, scallop or shrimp), clubhouse sandwich, pork chop, beef tagliata, porcini or blue-cheese risotto, tiramisu (2026 reviews) · wine, with a sommelier (Tabelog) · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999; four sharing five dishes paid ¥6,075 each with drinks (July 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町101

places.name: 弧玖 (Kokyu)
places.neighborhood: Demachi, where the Kamo and Takano rivers meet, near Shimogamo Shrine — 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto kaiseki from the day's best ingredients, every dish and arrangement carrying a meaning (official site) · lunch course ¥16,500 tax included (February 2026); the official site lists an omakase from ¥14,000 and says prices are not fixed — ask by phone · February 2026: sardine with sweet potato sushi; Awaji flounder with Shogoin turnip; white sweetfish soup; Miyagi chutoro and Shizuoka fugu; an assortment with karasumi and anko liver; root-celery hot pot with oysters and duck; rice with dashi omelette · September 2026: a Matsutake course with mackerel and fig on a bowl of Mie ice, Awaji anago soup with a full-moon tofu, a hassun with seasonal flowers · July 2026: an ayu course · sake list
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町204

places.name: KOKE
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Oike, ground floor of IDO KYOTO around a moss garden — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative course blending Okinawan food culture with Spanish technique and wood fire, cooked with well water drawn from the garden (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch ¥15,000, dinner ¥29,000 (about 20 dishes), tax included, +15% service (official site; Tabelog) · in-house alcohol and non-alcohol pairings, the latter by Madame Sachiko (August 2026) · 2026 dishes: a broth of island-pork cheek and kombu in spring water; a "Ryukyu plate" of small bites with house jimami tofu and sukugarasu on kombu cookies; firewood and Hanase binchotan cooking; dishes named in the Okinawan language · natural wines and sake
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区蛸薬師287 ido 1F

places.name: レ・シャンドール (Les Champs d'Or)
places.neighborhood: Yanaginobanba-dori near Rokkaku, in a townhouse in central Kyoto — 10 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French since 1983 — butter and cream sauces, generous plates (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch A ¥6,655 (starter, soup, fish or meat, dessert, coffee), lunch B ¥7,865, special 8-course "天上の晩餐" ¥21,780 at lunch or dinner, tax and service included (official site) · autumn 2026 dinner: snow crab and sea urchin in a fruit-and-vegetable jelly; braised abalone with grilled eggplant and caviar; Kumamoto guinea fowl, foie gras and plum terrine with chestnut cream; pan-roasted sea bream with sherry-vinegar sauce; roast duck with seared foie gras and fig; French cheeses (official site) · 2026 lunches: lobster bisque, crab gratin, red-wine-braised beef cheek, savarin, blancmange with peaches · wine list of Bordeaux, Burgundy, grower Champagne and Alsace (November 2025) · takeaway baked goods, duck roast and a New Year deli set (official site)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区柳馬場通六角下ル井筒屋町419

places.name: 鍵善良房 四条本店 (Kagizen Yoshifusa Shijo honten)
places.neighborhood: Gion, on Shijo-dori east of the Kamo River, toward Yasaka Shrine — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner of the Yasaka Shrine approach since the mid-Edo period, with a tea room behind the shop (official site; 2026 reviews) · the signature kuzukiri: kudzu noodles made to order, in iced water in a two-tier box, dipped in black or white syrup, ¥1,600 (October 2026) · warabi mochi in kinako; kibi mochi zenzai ¥1,400; hot or cold matcha; hojicha and a small sweet served on arrival (October 2026) · to take away: Kagimochi (firm warabi mochi in kinako) and seasonal wagashi (2026 reviews) · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側264

places.name: grains de vanille (グラン・ヴァニーユ)
places.neighborhood: 間之町通 south of Nijo, in a narrow lane near Karasuma-Oike — 4 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: French pâtisserie with about 20 cakes in the case, breads and an eat-in room with a view of the kitchen (official site; 2026 reviews) · cakes ¥880 in 2026: Meringue Groseille, Café Escargot, Marron et Passion, Praline Cassis, Montmorency (pistachio and cherry), Unique (cheese and orange); a Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc finished to order; caramel cream puff; crème vanille · Sablé Vanille ¥800 · croissants; breads from about ¥300, cakes from about ¥500 (September 2026) · drinks such as seasonal muscat granita ¥750 · diners spend about ¥1,000–2,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町486

places.name: DODICI (ドーディチ)
places.neighborhood: 麩屋町通 north of Oike, opposite 白山神社 — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Italian omakase that changes every month — "DODICI" means twelve — using organic vegetables from 石割農園, duck and venison from 亀岡, and Omi beef from 中川畜産 (official site) · lunch ¥11,000 (8 dishes), dinner ¥19,800 (10 dishes), tax included, +10% service (official site) · sample autumn dinner: flounder carpaccio with lotus root and ginkgo; ginger consommé with winter melon; charcoal-grilled wild eel risotto with ume; foie gras flan; baked barracuda with a bagna cauda of house fish sauce; venison roast with grape sauce; Matsutake and surf clam spaghetti; pear soup; fig kataifi (official site) · 2026 reviews: a welcome of cold-brewed hojicha in the ground-floor lounge; a self-rolled piadina; Kyoto red chicken; olive-oil ice cream · about 500 wines; pairings
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区麩屋町通御池上ル上白山町239 白山神社前

places.name: 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月 本店 (Mangetsu Honten)
places.neighborhood: 鞠小路通 north of Imadegawa, near Hyakumanben — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner of the 阿闍梨餅: a moist, chewy skin around sweet red bean paste (official site; 2026 reviews) · a pack of five about ¥700 (October 2026) · also 蜜漬京納言, 京銘菓最中 and 眞菓満月 (official site); the 満月 sweet, white bean paste in a firm pastry, sold for a limited time (October 2026) · warm, freshly made 阿闍梨餅 at the main shop (September–October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区鞠小路通今出川上ル

places.name: 大極殿本舗 六角店 (Daigokuden Honpo Rokkaku)
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori east of Takakura, a late-Edo machiya with a tea room at the back — 5 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: A confectioner founded in 1885 and credited with bringing castella to Kyoto, with a tea room behind the shop (October 2026 review) · signature Kohaku Nagashi: smooth agar jelly with a syrup and toppings that change every month — grape with wine jelly and raisins in September, chestnut and azuki zenzai in October, persimmon in November (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) — ¥950–980, or ¥1,450 with mini warabi mochi (2026 reviews) · very soft warabi mochi with kinako ¥980; zenzai with three kinds of mochi ¥1,500; 相生ぜんざい with white azuki (November 2026); kakigori such as Uji milk (September 2026) · cold hojicha in place of water; matcha · to take away: castella "Harunoya"
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区六角通高倉東入ル南側堀之上町120

places.name: 宝泉 JR新幹線京都駅店 (Hosen, Kyoto Station)
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, inside the Shinkansen gates on the 2F Hachijo-side concourse
places.cuisine: The Kyoto Station outlet of Housendo, an azuki-bean confectioner of Shimogamo that buys top Tanba black soybeans and Tanba dainagon azuki each year and avoids preservatives (official site) · tea room: dainagon zenzai and white-azuki zenzai with grilled mochi ¥1,400; seasonal chestnut shiruko; chestnut kinton with matcha; matcha float ¥1,300; hojicha served alongside (October 2026) · to take away: chestnut kinton ¥490 (Tanba chestnuts and trehalose only), Kamo Aoi with Tanba dainagon azuki (October 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3 新幹線 JR京都駅 2F

places.name: 祇園 末友 (Gion Suetomo)
places.neighborhood: Yasaka-dori in Gion, facing the south gate of Kenninji — tell a taxi "Kenninji south gate"
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of about eight dishes with monthly menus, cooked with "Yasaka water" drawn from 40 m underground; a sakizuke on a seasonal word and a hassun on Kyoto culture; the grilled course is cooked in front of you even in private rooms (official site) · lunch 八坂懐石 ¥12,100; kaiseki ¥36,300 or ¥72,600 at lunch and dinner; winter crab omakase ¥60,500 / ¥72,600 (official site) · a vegan course without animal ingredients on request (official site) · July 2026 lunch: grilled eggplant; a Gion Matsuri hassun with sea-bream sushi in bamboo leaf; abalone soup; grilled turban shell, ayu, oysters and abalone; hamo shabu-shabu with Matsutake; ginger rice · April 2026: rice porridge with ume, temari sushi, charcoal-grilled anago · sake, shochu, wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区大和大路四条下ル小松町151-73

places.name: 私房菜 すみよし (PRIVATE KITCHEN SUMIYOSHI)
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, just north of the Kyoto National Museum, ground floor of メゾン・ナイアーデ — 1 min from the Umamachi bus stop
places.cuisine: Kyoto-leaning Chinese — a "new sensation of Chinese cuisine" (Tabelog shop text) — with set lunches and dinner courses (2026 reviews) · lunch A ¥2,500: appetiser salad of bang bang chicken, seared sea bream and jellyfish with nuts; two dim sum (xiaolongbao and shrimp dumplings); Sichuan mapo tofu; rice; dessert (August–September 2026); B and S lunches with steamed shark-fin soup or black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; an XO fried rice set · dinner "Seiryu" course ¥10,000: Chinese-style sea bream sashimi, shark fin, Peking duck, sweet sea bream, beef with Matsutake, fried rice with crisp rice, fried almond jelly (October 2026) · Shaoxing wine, sake, shochu, wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区妙法院前側町420 メゾン・ナイアーデ 1F

places.name: イーパンツァイタナカ (Yi Pan Tsai Tanaka)
places.neighborhood: Tanaka, by Mototanaka Stn on the Eiden line, a street dense with Chinese restaurants — 5 min on foot
places.cuisine: Cantonese-based Chinese courses that change each visit, from a team trained in hotel Chinese kitchens (2026 reviews) · six-dish course ¥9,000 before tax at lunch and dinner (October 2026) · autumn 2026: an appetiser platter (Shaoxing-marinated sweet shrimp, steamed chicken with scallion oil, jellyfish, yuba-wrapped mushrooms, honey char siu); Jinhua-ham soups; dried abalone with shark fin; Matsutake xiaolongbao; Shanghai-crab spring rolls; soft-shell turtle; grouper with yellow chives; chestnut sticky rice · à la carte extras: mapo tofu with rice, hot-and-sour noodles and black-vinegar sudachi cold noodles ¥1,600, kadaif shrimp, almond tofu · gin, vodka, wines
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区田中里ノ内町26

places.name: fiveran (ファイブラン)
places.neighborhood: Between Karasuma and Horikawa south of Oike, a stylish bakery — about 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery with an eat-in space and coffee (2026 reviews) · examples with October 2026 prices: salt bread ¥149, black-sesame salt bread ¥167, black-bean kinako ¥260, croissant ¥280, milk France ¥320, maple cheddar bacon ¥353, croque monsieur ¥371, curry dog ¥408, chili dog ¥445 · also truffle salt bread, cheese France, coarse pork sausage, walnut baguette, bacon épi, cream buns, Earl Grey melon bread, raisin bread · espresso ¥463, hojicha latte ¥723
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区役行者町377

places.name: Flip up! (フリップアップ)
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori east of Muromachi, a tiny shop near Karasuma-Oike — 4 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Small bakery known for chewy bagels — more than ten kinds — plus hard breads, danishes and sweet buns, made with domestic and imported wheat and its own natural yeast (October 2026 review) · examples: chocolate bagel with black cocoa and 65% cacao chips; cheese bagel ¥280; pumpkin bagel with salted butter ¥280; white fig bagel; banana croissant with custard ¥260; heart-shaped cream bun ¥150; blue-cheese croissant; anpan; mentaiko French bread (October 2026) · diners spend under ¥1,000
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区押小路通室町東入ル蛸薬師町292-2

places.name: 炭焼創彩鳥家 人見 (Sumiyaki Sosai Toriya Hitomi)
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori at Nijo, a spacious old townhouse — about 7 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori over Kishu binchotan, ordered by the skewer, with Takasaka chicken and other breeds (2026 reviews) · a Takasaka chicken omakase of five cuts; neck, chicken-and-leek, skin, shiso rolls, tsukune, heart, gizzard, wings, liver comparisons between breeds; Kyoto duck loin (2026 reviews) · sides: free refills of cabbage with ponzu; chicken breast with yam and ume; steamed chicken with sansho sauce; potato salad; fried tofu; Kobe caciocavallo cheese · to finish: yakitori rice bowl, onigiri with sansho and chicken soup · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区二条通川端東入大菊町96

places.name: 焼肉やまちゃん (Yakiniku Yamachan)
places.neighborhood: Central Kyoto between Karasuma and Kawaramachi — 8 min from either station
places.cuisine: Course-only yakiniku of top-grade beef, grilled yourself at counters divided into pairs (2026 reviews) · omakase ¥13,500 tax included (2026) · signatures: a yukhoe shaped like a cow with egg yolk and a sweet sauce; thick tongue fresh enough to serve rare; a shabu-shabu of strip loin with Kujo negi; white tripe sashimi; skirt steak, including with miso sauce; kimchi and namul (2026 reviews) · finish with curry or cold noodles in three sizes, then milk pudding
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区蛸屋町157-11

places.name: オテルドゥオガワ (Hotel De Ogawa)
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo, unsigned on a hotel's ground floor — a short walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte izakaya cooking with kaiseki technique, from a blackboard menu without prices (2026 reviews) · signatures inherited from the parent shop: bone-in fried chicken with yuzu pepper, dashimaki, jako fried rice (October 2026) · also karasumi mochi, chicken wings, duck ham, sashimi platters and anago sashimi, Matsutake fry, fried guji, squid shumai, mackerel sushi, boiled octopus, simmered tofu, mentaiko pasta and the chef's own "My Napolitan" (August–October 2026) · shochu, sake, draft beer · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区西木屋町通四条下る船頭町230

places.name: ヴェーナ (Vena)
places.neighborhood: Near Karasuma-Marutamachi, a century-old townhouse with a garden — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian courses built on Kyoto ingredients — "what if there were a state called Kyoto in Italy?" — with wine or non-alcohol pairings by the sommelier (January 2026 review) · lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥24,000 tax and service included (Tabelog) · June 2026 dinner: new-onion capellini with torigai; striped jack tartare; fried young Lake Biwa ayu with burrata; seared sirloin carpaccio with summer truffle; hairy crab and sea urchin tagliolini; corn risotto with chorizo; Omi beef fillet; "Sun Egg" pudding with milk gelato · also raviolone with oozing yolk in the colder months, clam and edamame gratin, truffles shaved at the table, house grissini and bread · a cellar of wine by the door
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区鏡屋町46-3

places.name: 祇園 一道 (Gion Ichido)
places.neighborhood: Gion, on Nawate-dori just south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative teppan kaiseki: a Japanese base with Western touches, cooked on the griddle before you (2026 reviews) · omakase ¥30,000 before tax, up to ¥10,000 more in some seasons (Tabelog) · October 2026: ikura sticky rice; caramelised black fig with truffle; rare Spanish mackerel with caviar and ginkgo; beef tongue in white miso; steamed abalone with sea urchin; Matsutake fried noodles; a hamburg of tenderloin and foie gras with wasabi; tenderloin steak · earlier in 2026: Ise lobster in chili sauce, grilled milt yakisoba, kombu-cured firefly-squid yakisoba, Omi beef with bamboo shoots in white miso, sukiyaki, garlic rice, house ice cream · champagne and wine pairings
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側589 ぎをん松本ビル1階

places.name: 喫茶葦島 (Kissa Ashijima)
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Kawaramachi, fifth floor of the 文明堂ビル on the south-east corner — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee roasted in-house over direct flame in small batches, brewed cup by cup, with cakes chosen to pair (official site; 2026 reviews) · examples: Ashijima Blend ¥880; the house medium-roast "Hyakunen Coffee"; Mocha G1; Mandheling Aceh ¥1,200; iced café latte · cakes ¥750: the gluten-free Sanjo cheesecake of rice flour, a half-frozen Asamiya sencha cheesecake, cinnamon chocolate cake, matcha cheesecake · curry, the only meal · iced milk tea, decaf · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区三条通河原町東入大黒町37 文明堂ビル 5F

places.name: en boca Kyoto (エンボカ 京都)
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin-dori south of Rokkaku, a high-ceilinged renovated machiya — 7 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Wood-oven pizza topped with Japanese seasonal vegetables, and oven-roasted vegetable platters, in a renovated machiya (2026 reviews) · the popular lotus-root pizza with pesto; beef tendon and burdock; Manganji pepper and chirimen sansho; eggplant; autumn salmon and sanma; Margherita; quattro formaggi; dessert pizza; half-and-half to share (2026 reviews) · roast vegetables such as pumpkin, Kamiyama shiitake, zucchini, eggplant and sweet potato; Jamón Serrano and Iberico; octopus terrine; caprese · lunch course of appetisers, roast vegetables, soup, pizza and dessert (October 2026) · wine, sake, cocktails · diners spend about ¥3,000–7,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区西洞院六角下ル池須町406

places.name: 呑小路 やま岸 (Nominokoji Yamagishi)
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto City Hall, south of Oike — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: The casual, open-kitchen izakaya of Tomikoji Yamagishi: ingredients chosen by 山岸隆博, cooked with kappo technique (official site) · start with four omakase dishes (¥8,800, October 2026), then order freely: appetiser, sashimi, a main and a vegetable dish · 2026: steamed lotus root with white miso; sea bream and tuna; Densuke anago; ikura rice; grilled Spanish mackerel with miso; white sesame tofu with figs and chestnuts; fried Matsutake; oden; mackerel sushi; shrimp mayonnaise; shumai; simmered fried tofu with Kujo negi · wide sake list and wine · diners spend about ¥10,000–19,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区下白山町293-3

places.name: ルーデンス (LUDENS)
places.neighborhood: 間之町通 north of Nijo, near a street once lined with herbal-medicine wholesalers — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian-based "innovative fusion" with medicinal herbs and nourishing ingredients (official site) · a seasonal wellness course: medicinal soup, herbal soup, spiced appetisers, root vegetables, ravioli, chestnut risotto (October 2026); herbs and spices ground at the table to suit your condition (October 2026) · chef's counter 田淵薬膳研究所: a "seasonal yojo course" opening with a medicinal tea, four amuse-bouches, a vegetable plate and medicinal soup plus à la carte (official site) · wine, medicinal liqueurs and herbal drinks (official site) · spices to take home (August 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区間之町通二条上ル夷町560-8

places.name: フランソア喫茶室 (Salon de thé FRANCOIS)
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi, a lane just south of Shijo-Kobashi — 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A 1934 salon-style kissaten for coffee, tea and cakes (official site) · cake set ¥1,450: house rare cheesecake with blueberry sauce, pear tart, lemon tart (October 2026; Tabelog shop text) · special pudding with dried orange, pudding set ¥1,600 · coffee served with fresh cream; tea, including a "whiskey tea" and tea with a splash of brandy for aroma (October 2026) · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区西木屋町通四条下ル船頭町184

places.name: boulangerie Artisan'Halles (アルチザナル)
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori east of Teramachi, near the Kamo river delta and the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: French-style bakery of hard breads and viennoiserie, takeaway only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · examples (September–October 2026): basil sausage ¥360, pain au chocolat ¥320, cinnamon roll ¥360, smoked cheese and bacon ¥380, cream cheese ¥380, raisin bread ¥420, seasonal chestnut bread ¥480, fromage à la crème, cardamom roll, bacon épi, olive bread, tandoori chicken, sliced white loaf; danishes with custard or berries and white chocolate · most items under ¥500
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市上京区今出川通寺町東入ル一真町89

places.name: 亀末廣 (Kamesuehiro)
places.neighborhood: Aneyakoji-dori near Karasuma-Oike, an old shopfront — 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner founded in 1804, said to be run by the seventh generation (August 2026 review) · dry sweets: the seasonal boxed assortment "Kyo no Yosuga", rakugan including a brown-rice one with salted soybeans · fresh sweets such as chestnut kinton and a raspberry jelly sweet · the senbei-manju "Miyo" ¥300, mochi wafers filled with bean paste to order · yokan, kintsuba, kuzuyaki; limited "Hoshi no Omoi" and "Karukaru" (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区姉小路車屋町東入ル車屋町251

places.name: 鮨まつもと (Sushi Matsumoto)
places.neighborhood: Gion south side, on the Yayoi-koji lane behind an indigo noren — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi in the line of Tokyo's Shinbashi Shimizu: red-vinegar rice without sugar, toppings cured and seasoned for sake (2026 reviews) · omakase only, lunch and dinner; a 17-piece lunch course (July 2026); diners report ¥20,000–29,999 · 2026 pieces: kombu-cured sea bream and flounder, sumi-ika, kohada, flaked and medium-fatty tuna, simmered clams from Kuwana, hokki clam, ayu, Lake Biwa trout, horse mackerel, purple and red sea urchin, ribbonfish, anago, kanpyo · small dishes such as white sweet sea bream with kinome, tomato with mozuku · sake, shochu, wine, highballs
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-123

places.name: 味 ふくしま (Aji Fukushima)
places.neighborhood: Gion, a lane off Hanamikoji in a former teahouse — 7–8 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki served dish by dish in a renovated machiya that was a Gion teahouse (2026 reviews) · lunch omakase ¥7,150 (December 2025) with a bento, rice refills; dinner about ¥20,000–29,999 · spring 2026: firefly squid with broad beans; kombu-cured sea bream and aged tuna; clam shinjo soup; icefish tempura; milt rice; a hassun for the cherry blossoms; bamboo shoots · winter 2025: yuzu soup with soy-milk sauce, steamed sushi with seiko crab · sake and wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570

places.name: 一子相伝 なかむら (Isshisoden Nakamura)
places.neighborhood: Tomikoji-dori just south of Oike, behind a white noren — near Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto ryori, kaiseki courses with house dishes handed down from father to son (official site) · signatures: guji salted overnight, sprinkled with sake and grilled, then finished with hot water poured over the bones as a soup; white-miso zoni made with water and no dashi, with a grilled round mochi and thin mustard (official site) · 2026 courses: hishi crab with ikura and yam; sashimi of shrimp, sea bream and octopus; scooped tofu with hamo-bone crackers; summer courses with hamo, ayu, sea urchin and hairy crab · the house sake 「Aoko」 (as written in reviews) brewed for Nakamura · diners report ¥20,000–29,999 at lunch and ¥40,000–49,999 at dinner
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区富小路御池下ル136

places.name: 青いけ (Aoike)
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori west of Takakura, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French omakase built on vegetables — about 60 kinds, grown and picked by the chef each morning (January and May 2026 reviews) — served on Venetian glass (2025 reviews) · lunch ¥9,800–22,000 and dinner ¥14,000–27,000 for 6 to 8+ dishes, tax included, from January 2026 (official site) · signature vegetable terrine of individually cooked vegetables wrapped in cabbage; vegetable mousses with consommé jelly; Omi beef skirt with mustard sauce (January 2026); potato and melon vichyssoise (July 2026); chawanmushi with eel and Matsutake, Spanish mackerel with anchovy-hazelnut sauce (2025) · reasonably priced wine
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区竹屋町通高倉西入塀之内町631

places.name: 佳肴 岡もと (Kakou Okamoto)
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama near the Umacho bus stop, away from the tourist streets — 2 min from the bus stop
places.cuisine: One seasonal omakase at an eight-seat counter, with a strong dashi and French-touched creativity (2025–2026 reviews) · July 2026: shijimi kuzu soup with junsai and cucumber flowers; striped jack, sea urchin and shirasu over somen with grilled-eggplant purée; sea bass with egg tofu in a clear soup · signatures: shark-fin noodles with chapon chicken broth, natural karasumi, saba sushi (2025–2026) · winter 2026: shrimp yam with caviar, tiger fugu with sea urchin, crab soup in a treasure-box dish, Ise lobster · a wide sake list with pairings
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区常盤町470-4

places.name: 京中華 牧定 (Kyoto Chuka Makisada)
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori south of Nijo, between Karasuma-Oike and City Hall — 5 min from either station

places.cuisine: Ohagi only, in three kinds — kinako, koshian (smooth bean paste) and tsubuan (chunky) — ¥240 each, three for ¥720 (September–October 2026) · soft, partly mashed glutinous rice and mildly sweet paste
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区烏丸五条西入ル一筋目下ル横諏訪町312
