places.neighborhood: Yoshida, near Hyakumanben — 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Konpeito, Japanese sugar candy, from a shop founded in 1847 and described as Japan's only konpeito specialist (September 2026 reviews) · seasonal and fruit flavours such as La France pear, mikan, peach, melon, lemon, strawberry, grape, cider; matcha, black sesame and buckwheat, vanilla, cinnamon, chestnut · small bags ¥750; "Estrela" rich matcha konpeito ¥1,580; gift tins and bamboo baskets (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区吉田泉殿町38番地の2

places.name: Yosuke YAMAJI (山地陽介)
places.neighborhood: Gion, the south side lanes off Hanamikoji — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative French with Japanese seasonal sensibility, using organic produce from the chef's family farm (September 2026) · lunch course ¥6,800 (an 11th-anniversary course with Kyoto Akadori chicken, October 2026); dinner course ¥12,000 (September 2026) · dishes described as creative and boldly combined, with complex sauces and careful plating; the menu reads like an essay (October 2026) · wine with a sommelier; coffee, tea or hojicha with dessert
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-151

places.name: fudo
places.neighborhood: Oike-dori near City Hall, down an outdoor stair to a basement — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Italian technique with Japanese seasonal ingredients — "fudo" means climate — with Japanese wines (2026 reviews) · signatures: foie gras marinated in Saikyo miso with fresh yatsuhashi; pasta in sea-bream broth with plenty of karasumi; sweetfish risotto with three whole confit ayu; chicken white-liver with spiced baguette; steak with a condiment-rich broth; figs fried with lots of pepper; eel and chili pasta; spencer roll (September–October 2026) · aromatic non-alcohol drinks; Japanese wine pairings · diners spend about ¥8,000–14,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区御池大東町590 加納ビル B1F

places.name: ソローノ (Solono)
places.neighborhood: Anekoji-dori east of Shinmachi, a short walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Authentic Neapolitan pizza from a wood-fired oven, ¥1,900–2,500 each (October 2026) · Margherita; funghi with Parmigiano grated at the table; gorgonzola; Bismarck; Siciliana; Genovese with onion sauce and smoked cheese; a pizza with spicy house salami; quattro formaggi · served with a spicy basil oil for the crust · antipasti: ham with tuna sauce, burrata caprese, grapes with burrata, meatballs in tomato · wine, sake, shochu, cocktails · diners spend about ¥2,000–3,999
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区新町姉小路東入ル町頭町90-3

places.name: 祇園 丸山 (Gion Maruyama)
places.neighborhood: Gion, the south-side lanes east of Hanamikoji — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki with careful presentation, served in private rooms over a garden (2026 reviews) · April 2026 seasonal course ¥75,900: a sakura and gold-leaf platter, bamboo shoots several ways, firefly squid with broad beans, sakura sea bream with tuna, grilled moroko, sea-bream roe and monkfish, pea and egg rice · December 2025: a ¥50,000 (before tax) course with crab · ayu in summer (September 2025) · sake, shochu, wine; service 15% · the shop also sells take-home dishes such as seasonal rice and hot-pot sets (official site)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-171

places.name: 二条城ふる田 (Nijojo Furuta)
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori near Nijo Castle, behind a modest sign — 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: A one-chef counter of charcoal-grilled seasonal fish and dashi-led Japanese cooking, ending with takikomi rice (2025–2026 reviews) · omakase from ¥20,000; ingredient-led course from ¥30,000 at market price (Tabelog) · summer 2025: generous summer dishes and grilled bonito; June 2026: watermelon and mango to finish · sake and wine (a June 2026 diner found drinks pricey)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区押小路通小川西入ル古城町371

places.name: スマート珈琲店 (Smart Coffee)
places.neighborhood: Teramachi arcade north of Sanjo — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto kissaten, said to date from 1932 (October 2026 reviews): coffee downstairs, a western-style lunch room upstairs · pancakes with butter and maple syrup (pancake set ¥1,400), French toast, firm house pudding ¥700, mixed sandwich of ham and egg or vegetables and dashi-rolled omelette ¥900 · coffee ¥650; beans to take home · upstairs lunch such as hamburg steak (2021 visit)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区寺町通三条上ル天性寺前町537

places.name: ワルダー (Warder)
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho-dori south of Rokkaku, opposite a small park — 8 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small bakery packed with hard breads, danishes and filled breads under handwritten signs (2026 reviews) · examples: Kyoto dashi bread with iriko and katsuobushi (two per person); baked curry bread with curry from the Osaka shop Navin; Shiba-zuke French bread; garlic French; squid-ink bread; pistachio an-butter sandwich; cheese pretzel ¥270; banana-caramel bread ¥370; chestnut pie and chestnut danish; tea croissant with almond and apple; sausage focaccia; canelé; sliced loaf (September–November 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区麩屋町六角下ル坂井町452 ハイマート・ふや町 1F

places.name: 喫茶 マドラグ (Kissa Madrague)
places.neighborhood: West of Karasuma, north of Oike — 9 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Retro kissaten that carries on two closed Kyoto shops: the coffee house Kissa Seven (the building) and the western-style restaurant Corona (its egg sandwich) (official site) · Corona egg sandwich: a thick, hot dashi omelette on bread spread with demi-glace and mustard, ¥1,180 · Set A breakfast with two pieces of it, salad, prosciutto, soup, yogurt and a drink ¥1,800 (November 2026) · thick toast, pizza toast, iron-plate Napolitan ¥1,100, pork curry rice ¥990, carbonara · blend coffee ¥600, Monte Carlo (Vienna-style coffee) ¥600, banana juice, cream soda; beer, highball, whisky, Calvados (official menu)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区上松屋町706-5

places.name: マリベル 京都本店 (MarieBelle Kyoto)
places.neighborhood: Yanagibaba-dori south of Sanjo — 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto main shop of the New York chocolatier MarieBelle, in a townhouse with an antique-furnished café, the Cacao Bar (official site; 2026 reviews) · art ganache printed with artists’ designs, sold in the blue box (two pieces ¥1,900); Carré de Chocolat squares (8 pieces ¥2,500); sablés and cookies · café: hot chocolate, chocolate crepe ¥1,430, gelato two flavours ¥1,430, autumn chestnut-and-kadaif chocolate crepe ¥2,500, New York cheesecake, quiche, seasonal tasting set (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区柳馬場三条下ル槌屋町83番地

places.name: 赤垣屋 (Akagakiya)
places.neighborhood: Kawabata Nijo by the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: One of Kyoto’s oldest izakaya, founded in 1934 and on this site since 1949 (an October 2026 review) · duck loin roast with a sweet soy-based sauce and mustard (ordered by almost every table) · shime saba with onion and herbs · kumiage yuba with plum-wasabi · Kyoto-style oden: octopus (order early), rolled cabbage, daikon, egg, atsuage · simmered small taro with yuzu · grilled eel with wasabi soy or ponzu · sesame tofu, tempura, yakitori · hot sake, shochu, beer (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区孫橋町9

places.name: ZEN CAFE (Kagizen Yoshifusa)
places.neighborhood: Gion back street south of Shijo, opposite the ZENBI museum — 158 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Café of the old wagashi house Kagizen Yoshifusa (Tabelog; 2026 reviews): Kagizen’s wagashi with tea, coffee, fresh juices and sparkling water · kuzumochi ¥1,200 (also as a set with a drink) · kuzukiri with black syrup ¥1,200 · zenzai ¥1,200 · seasonal jo-namagashi ¥1,000, e.g. chestnut kinton in autumn, with sencha or green tea · seasonal fruit sandwiches (chestnut, fig) · persimmon juice in autumn (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-210

places.name: イグレック (Ygrec)
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi just north of Shijo, by the river — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: European-style curry with three choices — vegetable, beef and small shrimp — plus a few soups and appetisers (July 2026) · vegetable curry ¥1,400 (August 2026): about ten kinds of seasonal vegetables, raw, pickled, grilled, steamed and deep-fried, over the sauce (2024–2026 reviews) · small shrimp curry ¥1,400 and homemade seasonal soup (corn) ¥600 (July 2026) · pickled cabbage and diced raw yam on the side (April 2025) · wine, with a sommelier on hand (Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区西木屋町四条上ル真町455

places.name: 高瀬川 槇 (Takasegawa Maki)
places.neighborhood: Back street on the Takase River south of Shijo — 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Uwajima-style tai-meshi from Ehime, made by a couple from Uwajima (official site): raw sea bream sashimi over rice with the house dashi soy sauce and an egg yolk, rather than rice cooked with the fish · lunch gozen: tai-meshi gozen ¥2,200, double sea bream ¥2,860, triple ¥3,520, with salmon roe ¥2,860, with sea urchin ¥3,000, sea urchin and salmon roe ¥3,660, with grated yam ¥2,530; the same as a jubako box from ¥2,200 (official site) · the gozen comes with simmered greens and white miso soup (August 2026) · lunch tai-meshi course in a clay pot ¥6,600 (6 dishes); abalone clay-pot rice and abalone ramen course ¥8,800 (Tabelog); dinner course ¥16,500 (official site) · rice from Kumakogen, Ehime, grown with reduced pesticides at 800 m; Shimanto River water for all cooking; barley miso (official site) · the okami’s brother’s mikan juice from Uwajima, ¥715 (July 2026), also as a chuhai; draft beer and sake (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区市之町240-2

places.name: 日本料理 とくを (Japanese cuisine Tokuo)
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori north of Bukkoji, by the Takase River — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo-style Japanese cooking from ingredients the owner-chef buys every morning, as courses or, at the counter, à la carte (official site; Tabelog) · lunch omakase ¥10,800 with tax and service (11 dishes), lunch short course ¥8,400 (8 dishes); dinner omakase ¥24,000 (13 dishes), dinner short course ¥16,200 (9 dishes) (official site, prices from 1 February 2026) · signature dishes: marunabe (soft-shelled turtle hot pot) and wagyu grilled slowly over charcoal (Tabelog shop text) · a lunch course in August 2026: fish-stock jelly, seasonal ohitashi, hamo, bluefin tuna, chawanmushi, breadcrumbed fries, karasumi daikon, Saikyo-yaki, grilled nama-fu, uzaku, simmered kinmedai, rice with chirimen sansho · homemade karasumi and warabi mochi (2026 reviews) · sake from Kyoto, Fukui, Niigata and beyond; Swiss and Bulgarian wines, Kenzo Estate wines, shochu, fruit liqueurs (official site)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区木屋町通り仏光寺上る天王町151

places.name: 鳥かご (Tori Kago)
places.neighborhood: Mibu, a residential street near Shijo-Omiya — 2 min walk from Shijo-Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori omakase grilled over strong, direct charcoal heat in the Torishiki style (2026 reviews) · 11 skewers with pickles, chicken soup, a rice dish and dessert, ¥15,000 (soft drinks) or ¥17,000 (all drinks) (Tabelog; July 2026) · Date chicken (two July 2026 reviews) · skewers vary by day: thigh, gizzard, neck, shiitake, maruhatsu (whole heart), outside skirt, wings, tsukune, chōchin, liver, corn, eggplant, atsuage · to finish: oyakodon, tsukune rice bowl with a raw egg (July 2024), kamameshi or takikomi gohan (2024–2026 reviews) · beer and about ten sakes (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区壬生坊城町8-24

places.name: 小林酒店 (Kobayashi Saketen)
places.neighborhood: Kayukoji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 88 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar laid out like a liquor shop: pick a bottle or can from the fridges and drink it there (2025–2026 reviews) · canned craft beer, e.g. a collaboration beer of the shop, KITSUNE (a light lager made with Omi Koshihikari rice), Habakari-san from Kyoto ¥1,200, HINO from Shiga ¥1,260 · Japanese sake, wine, local dry gin (Nozawa Onsen Dry Gin), cocktails · small plates: fried spring rolls with mackerel and tomato ¥660, steamed chicken, an assorted three-snack platter, baguette and dip; an August 2025 review describes creative obanzai with seasonal fish from Nishiki Market and vegetables from Ohara (2025–2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-1

places.name: さらさ花遊小路 (Sarasa Kayu Koji)
places.neighborhood: Kayukoji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 1 min from Kawaramachi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Café by day, a place for a drink and food at night (official site), with international dishes, house-made cakes and freshly roasted coffee (Tabelog) · lunch plate about ¥1,350 (October 2026) · daily lunch sets ¥1,280, e.g. pork chinjao rosu, chili-style chicken kara-age (October 2026) · chicken curry ¥1,100, drink set +¥300 (August 2026) · kara-age plate, tonkatsu, chicken katsu set, taco rice, dry curry with cheese and egg, chicken steak with onion sauce (rice extra), carrot croquette (2026 reviews) · spiced chai parfait ¥750, caramel cheesecake, pumpkin cheesecake, double chocolate cake · coffee, iced coffee; beer, wine, shochu, cocktails (official site; Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-13

places.name: メゾン ド フルージュ (maison de frouge)
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Patisserie and small café that makes only strawberry sweets, from fully ripe strawberries sent from farms across Japan, a different variety each day (official site) · premium strawberry shortcake ¥1,430 on the official list; ¥1,450 plus tax (October 2026) and ¥1,595 eaten in (September 2026) · strawberry mille-feuille ¥1,078, two per person, tied with a ribbon cut with small scissors · strawberry tart ¥1,430 · strawberry and rhubarb cheese tart ¥902 · strawberry cheesecake ¥880 · roll cake ¥702 · tea and berry mousse ¥858 · strawberry pudding ¥418 (official site, undated prices) · strawberry trifle ¥380 plus tax (October 2026) · strawberry financier, raspberry marshmallow, raspberry and pistachio madeleine · wild berry tea ¥880, iced café latte ¥990 (September 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201 1F

places.name: ザ・コモン・ワン・バー・キョウト (The Common One Bar Kyoto)
places.neighborhood: Gion Shinbashi by the Shirakawa, off Yamatooji — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Cocktail and whisky bar in a renovated Gion machiya with a garden behind the counter (official site; 2026 reviews) · cocktails with seasonal fresh fruit, e.g. plum, kiwi (July 2026) · classics: Martini with Tanqueray and Noilly Prat, Rob Roy with The Balvenie 12, gin and tonic, Jack Rose, mojito, piña colada, Red Eye with Heartland beer, Bull-Dog · single malts as highballs or shots (Glen Moray, GlenDronach, Ardbeg, Glenmorangie), Calvados soda, vermouth · flavoured vodkas · non-alcoholic cocktails and lower-strength drinks on request (2026 reviews) · two drinks and the cover came to ¥4,700 (May 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区新橋通大和大路東入元吉町46 何生館内

places.name: Hyssop (ヒソップ)
places.neighborhood: Shijo Kawaramachi, next to Takashimaya — 4F of GOOD NATURE STATION, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual restaurant of healthy, vegetable-centred dishes in a plant-filled room with an open-atrium terrace (official site); vegetables mostly from producers in Kyoto, cooked simply (Tabelog) · seasonal lunch sets with a medicinal-food theme: Summer Balanced Meal ¥2,500 (soup, five small deli dishes, charcoal-grilled Tanba chicken, multigrain rice, tofu pudding; September 2026), Autumn Hyssop Lunch Set ¥3,400 (vegetable mousse and shojin jelly, saury and cauliflower bagna salad, minestrone, roast Kyoto pork with mustard sauce, mini douhua, coffee or tea; Tabelog, September 2026) · dinner à la carte: hors d’oeuvre ¥2,200, farm tomato and burrata caprese ¥2,400, long pasta with Kyoto duck ragù ¥2,400, charcoal-grilled venison with mushroom koji-miso sauce 100 g ¥4,000, roast Kameoka beef loin 120 g ¥5,400 (official site) · party plans with free-flow drinks ¥6,500 and ¥9,500 (Kameoka beef) (Tabelog); summer "Nature Beer Terrace 2026" free-flow course ¥5,500 (July 2026) · cocktails, wine, sake, elderflower soda ¥500
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区河原町通四条下ル2丁目稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 4F

places.name: 京都 鉄板焼 grow (Kyoto Teppanyaki grow)
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori east of Kawaramachi, basement — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn Exit 2
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki counter for black wagyu and lobster; an undated macaro-ni article calls the beef A5 grade at reasonable prices (macaro-ni) · most popular dinner (Tabelog): 10 dishes with Ise lobster teppanyaki, lean black wagyu steak and 2-hour free-flow drinks ¥14,000 — foie gras roast beef, seared wagyu sushi, dish of the day (wagyu tomato stew with baguette), wagyu and taro chawanmushi, Ise lobster with Kujo-negi sauce and lobster-broth sauce, salad with anchovy-garlic sauce, wagyu katsu sandwich with shibazuke tartar, steak (upgrade strip loin +¥1,600, tenderloin +¥2,700, Chateaubriand +¥3,800) with whipped soy-sauce foam, garlic rice ball finished with broth, panna cotta (October–November 2026) · lunch wagyu lean steak course, 9 dishes ¥6,600, abalone or lobster extra (Tabelog) · Christmas course 24–25 December ¥15,000 (Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区真町88-3 ユーイットゥ池善ビル B1F

places.name: LA VOITURE
places.neighborhood: Shogoin, south of Marutamachi near Heian Shrine — 15 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tarte tatin shop and café in Okazaki (official site): each tart uses about 20 apples caramelised with butter and sugar for over four hours (Fashion Headline, 2016; Leaf Kyoto, 2021) · choose among two to four apple varieties by season — Fuji all year, plus e.g. サンつがる, Shinano Gold, Iwai, Olin (2026 reviews) — served warm with unsweetened yogurt · tarte tatin (Fuji) ¥950, takeaway slice ¥1,000 · walnut caramel tart ¥730 · Darjeeling with a cake ¥730, iced café au lait ¥800, apple-caramel flavoured tea (September–October 2026) · by mail, frozen: 2 slices ¥2,250, 15 cm whole tart ¥7,150 (official online shop, sold out at the time of reading)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市左京区聖護院円頓美町47-5

places.name: 酒処 てらやま (Sake Dokoro Terayama)
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji, west of Kawaramachi, down an alley — 6–8 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Counter izakaya-kappo of seasonal fish and sake (2025–26 reviews) · sashimi (seared hamo, sea urchin, squid, tuna), shime saba, first-of-season saury, seared sawara, hamo nanban with okra, hamo with matsutake, sea urchin with eggplant, rock oysters with sea grapes · maguro namero, kabura-mushi with wasabi, dashimaki, oden (from October 2026), chicken wings (single wings can be ordered), toro-taku, kizushi, fried matsutake, ginkgo nuts · to finish: beef curry rice with garlic rice, fried rice, the "famous" beef katsu sandwich, crusts cut off · sake chosen for you, hot sake, Hakushu and Yamazaki highballs, homemade lemon sour (2024–26 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区綾小路通足袋屋町317-11

places.name: NIKOLABO (ニコラボ)
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Shijo — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian wine bistro built on stews — the official site calls it ワインのための煮込み料理研究所, a research lab for stews to go with wine; produce and fish come from Kyotango, the chef’s home area (official site) · Kyotango fish carpaccio ¥1,200 (fish of the day) · caprese of Kumihama Toma Kobo fruit tomato and buffalo mozzarella ¥1,200 · more than 30 stews, e.g. tripe in tomato ¥1,680, coq au vin ¥2,300, carbonade (beef in beer) ¥2,400, saffron-stewed Kyotango fish ¥2,600 · risotto with scallops ¥1,880, black-tea chiffon cake with vanilla ice cream ¥800 (Tabelog menu, December 2024) · braised pork belly with a choice of sauces (lotus root, apple, sansho), lamb stewed in tomato, oven-baked chicken wings, water eggplant with parmesan, persimmon and gorgonzola canapés, taro fritters, rice croquettes, pasta with gorgonzola or oyster cream (2023–26 reviews) · over 40 wines chosen by the chef, who is a sommelier; glass from ¥780, bottle from ¥3,900; draft beer ¥600, highball ¥700 (official site; Tabelog menu, December 2024)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区稲荷町329 エリッツ四条河原町ビル 2F

places.cuisine: Creative vegetable dishes and natural wine, mostly Italian in style, with organic vegetables from Shizuhara and Tango (2026 reviews) · seen: Kamo eggplant steak, hummus, grilled zucchini, herb salad of okra and moringa on couscous, sansho pâté, bonito carpaccio, oysters with turnip and turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti, chestnut cream pasta with mushrooms and chicken, duck with red-wine sauce, roast pork with red wine and miso, red-shrimp américaine, white miso with prosciutto and Shine Muscat (2025–2026 reviews) · desserts such as jasmine-tea tiramisu, chamomile-jelly panna cotta, affogato (2026 reviews) · natural wine, Belgian beer, non-alcoholic cocktails (2025–2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区船頭町235

places.name: くずし理 (Kuzushi Kotowari)
places.neighborhood: Between Shijo and Gojo — 10 min walk from Gojo Stn and Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: "Kuzushi kappo": creative Japanese with Western touches, one monthly course of about eight dishes for ¥8,800 (official site) · sakizuke, five small appetizers, a soup, sashimi with house-made vegetable soy sauces (grilled-corn soy with flounder), a main "kuzushi" dish, a vinegared course, rice and dessert (official site) · seen: hamo tempura with green-plum purée, asparagus and isaki in clam broth with truffle oil, Kamo eggplant dengaku with grilled-ayu sauce, buri and turnip, soft-roe tempura, guji rice, sakura-shrimp mochi in white miso, cold dashi chazuke with jelly (official site; 2024–2026 reviews) · foie-gras sushi ¥800 (Tabelog)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区万寿寺通堺町東入俵屋町239-2

places.name: LA RISOTTERIA
places.neighborhood: Daimaru Kyoto 8F, Shijo-Karasuma — linked to Karasuma and Shijo Stns
places.cuisine: Milanese risotto bar using aged Italian rice, with ossobuco on saffron risotto as the specialty (Tabelog) · lunch A (pasta or risotto, dessert, drink) ¥2,200, porcini risotto +¥1,100; lunch B with appetizer plate and soup (2026 reviews) · dinner pair set of appetizers, a risotto and a pasta for two with a drink each ¥8,800; ossobuco alla milanese ¥6,600; Bolognese, Margherita pizza (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区四条通高倉西入立売西町79 大丸京都店 8F

places.name: おそば宝来 (Osoba Horai)
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in a narrow alley — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night soba and small plates from the 和食 宝来 group: juwari (100% buckwheat) soba — mori soba, duck soba with kabosu, cold duck soba, beef tendon and Kujo negi soba, green curry soba, white sweet potato and ginger-sauce soba, kake soba (2026 reviews) · sashimi (bonito, hamo, squid), tender simmered octopus, saba sushi, karasumi mochi, fried white shrimp, kisu tempura, duck roast, sansho-grilled chicken, fugu and oysters in season; sake such as Hidakami (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側338-4

places.name: 京氷菓 つらら (Kyo Hyoka Tsurara)
places.neighborhood: Nishinokyo west of Nijo Castle — 10 min from JR Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kakigori with seasonal fruit syrups and creams, changing through the year: chestnut caramel pie and Japanese chestnut hojicha milk, persimmon or grape with gorgonzola, fig and sansho cream cheese, strawberry mascarpone, tiramisu, peach and muscat in season, a pumpkin Halloween special (2025–26 reviews) · about ¥1,700 a bowl (September 2026)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区西ノ京内畑町22

places.name: 野菜と魚 en (Yasai to Sakana en)
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji near Shijo-Karasuma, in a machiya alley — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A "slightly more adult" izakaya of seasonal vegetables and fish: charcoal-grilled salmon potato salad, straw-smoked bonito with onions from an Awaji farm, tempura with house lemon pepper, namero, spring rolls of Aomori apple and sweet potato with Kumamoto ricotta, served on Shigaraki and antique ware (Tabelog) · in reviews: Awaji pepper with salmon miso, bonito tataki in ponzu jelly, nameko tempura, a whole warm eggplant, eel claypot rice (leftovers made into onigiri to take home), lemongrass sour (2026 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市下京区綾小路柳馬場下ル永原町153-10

places.name: Planetarium Cafe&Bar Misora
places.neighborhood: North side of Gion near Yasaka Shrine — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Planetarium café and bar under a projected starry sky (2024–26 reviews) · original cocktails such as Shooting Star (apple), Eclat (mango), Apollo (chocolate liqueur and cranberry sorbet), Soleil, with star-shaped ice or pineapple; drinks from ¥780 (July 2024) · five or more non-alcoholic cocktails, Shirley Temple · limited drinkable parfaits (mango, berry), chocolate churros, prosciutto and mozzarella (2024–26 reviews)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側281-1 祇園ファーストビル 4F

places.name: カフェビストロ オーボンモルソー (Cafe Bistro Au Bon Morceau)
places.neighborhood: Off Kawaramachi north of Sanjo — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Lyonnaise bistro cooking with organic wines (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · AAAAA-certified andouillette, the house speciality · boudin noir, branded sausages · escargots bourguignonne, French onion soup, soupe de poisson, foie gras terrine, smoked mackerel and potato salad, salmon salad · steak, onglet, beef braised in red wine with macaroni, horse tartare with chips · crêpes Suzette, baba · a starter-and-main set ¥2,000 (May 2025); glass of Côtes du Rhône ¥900 (September 2026) · bread served in a paper bag
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区河原町通三条上ル東入恵比須町534-18 ステラム 1F

places.name: 鰻・割烹 戸石 (Unagi Kappo Toishi)
places.neighborhood: Between Kyoto City Hall and Karasuma-Oike — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kansai-style jiyaki eel — grilled without steaming for a crisp skin — with seasonal kappo dishes (2026 reviews) · unaju of 1.5 eels (September 2026) · course ¥7,800 (July 2026); seasonal eel course ¥10,000 (September 2026): starters, sashimi, soup, chilled eel with myoga and cucumber in dashi jelly, tempura, kabayaki and shirayaki · donabe rice cooked to order with rice from the rice shop "Hachidaime Gihei" · male eels from Isshiki, per a July 2026 reviewer · crab and game in season (Tabelog categories)
places.address_ja: 京都府京都市中京区晴明町682

places.name: 喫茶 ソワレ (Kissa Soiree)
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo, by the Takase River — 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Blue-lit kissaten famous for five-colour jelly drinks (official site) · jelly punch with Kobe local cider ¥850, jelly punch float ¥950, yogurt punch ¥1,000, jelly milk ¥800, jelly yogurt ¥850, jelly coffee ¥850, jelly wine ¥900, jelly coffee float ¥950 · ice cream ¥800, seasonal ice cream ¥850, orange sherbet ¥800, kiwi float (May–December) ¥950 · cream soda in six colours ¥800, cream coffee ¥800, cream cocoa ¥850, cream cola ¥800 · cake ¥550, thick toast to share (butter and cinnamon sugar, jam and marmalade, or chocolate and cream) ¥650 · blend coffee in Koransha cups with line drawings made for the shop by 東郷青児 (official menu) · iced lemon tea ¥650 (September 2026)
